name: rendered-strip
description: The rendered strip (`RenderedStrip`, `tento-core-js/sheet-layout/rendered-strip.ts`) under the scroll viewport's policy (`RenderedStrip.VIEWPORT`): visible count N of equal integer-width columns, column `step` the first visible one, and the inclusive rendered indices. Pinned on the layout side through the DOM's own `ScrollViewport` (`tento-scroll-js/engine/rendered-strip.deno.test.ts`) and on the CLI side through `renderedRange` (`tento-lona-js/cli/dom-window.deno.test.ts`): an overscan change fails both.
